notes:
Quick CRM snapshot: Alderbend is a mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) building a semantic search layer for product docs, support tickets and event-guides. Primary eval: embeddings+semantic-search; starting Hosted proof-of-concept, then will validate Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Highlights/quotes: "We need 95th p90 query latency <50ms for small queries, throughput 150–250 QPS during peak, and nightly batch ingest ~15M vectors/day." — Head of Platform (call 2026-02-12).

Product constraints: heavy batch ETL (Airflow) into vector DB, multi-tenant index per customer, nightly reindexing windows, nearline cold storage for historical vectors. Preference for an API that supports bulk upsert and async job status. Interested in auto-batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization recommendations to cut GPU cost.

Security & compliance: must support SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retained 90 days (for now), KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for a subset of customers. They asked for SOC2 and ISO info during initial call.

POC notes: Started Hosted test in Feb 2026 using Redwood hosted embeddings + query endpoint. Early results: embeddings quality OK, but saw latency spikes when concurrent batch upserts triggered. SE suggested Dedicated pool for isolation and steady tail latency.

Sales notes: Interested in committed capacity for deterministic pricing if performance proven. Price sensitivity: mid-market procurement; wants 12mo commit if unit economics drop >20% vs hosted.

Stubs/links: Fireflies meeting id ff_16782_ald, pricing_deck_v2 (drive link), security_faq.pdf (drive link). Gmail thread ids noted for eng/legal threads.
